title: A storyboard app joins the catalog
summary:
A new community storyboard app, clearer app authorization, and model usage estimates made for a day of useful housekeeping.

The community app catalog added @eneryu’s Onyx, which turns scripts into noir-style visual storyboards. A duplicate TeleChars AI listing was also consolidated.

A new Bring Your Own Pollen guide explains how apps can let people authorize with Pollinations and use their own Pollen. The authorization screen now identifies the app receiving access more plainly.

Enter’s model table now estimates how far one Pollen goes using observed usage, with workload-based estimates when that data is unavailable. A public endpoint also provides aggregated model usage stats.

highlights.title: Bring Your Own Pollen
highlights.text: Build apps where people authorize with Pollinations and use their own Pollen. The authorization screen now makes clearer which app they’re connecting to. [Connect user wallets](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/connect-user-wallets).
